openclaw_command.description: OpenClaw executable name or path. Relative paths containing a directory are resolved from the NeMo Fabric base directory.

agent_id.description: OpenClaw agent selected for SDK invocations and managed native clients.

channel_config.description: OpenClaw-native channels and bindings for NeMo Fabric-owned services. Every binding must target the configured agent. Managed runtimes reject channel configuration.

port_range.description: Inclusive consumer-allocated port range. The adapter selects a Gateway base port whose complete derived footprint through base + 110 fits within the range. When omitted, the adapter selects an available local range.

enabled.description: Serve the Control UI. A present dashboard is on unless this is false.

port.description: Exact loopback Gateway base port, which serves the Control UI. Start fails if it or port + 2 is in use. OpenClaw allocates browser ports through port + 110 on demand, so keep that range free. Can't be combined with port_range.

public_origins.description: Additional browser HTTP(S) origins. OpenClaw also permits loopback origins; the token is always required.

dashboard.description: OpenClaw's Control UI. After the Gateway starts, the adapter writes its sign-in token to <state_dir>/interfaces/dashboard.token with runtime.keep_state, or <artifact root>/.fabric/openclaw/runtimes/<runtime-id>/interfaces/dashboard.token for ephemeral state.

terminal.description: Attach the native terminal to the existing Gateway. No terminal port; publishes a private executable launcher and terminal.running marker.

interfaces.description: Native interfaces served by a managed runtime. Services reject interfaces.

startup_timeout_seconds.description: One deadline for all of start, from checking the OpenClaw command to the Gateway becoming ready, within NeMo Fabric's 90-second start limit.

shutdown_timeout_seconds.description: Maximum graceful Gateway shutdown time before forced termination.

connect_timeout_seconds.description: Timeout for connecting to the local OpenClaw Gateway.

read_timeout_seconds.description: Timeout between response bytes from the local OpenClaw Gateway. When unset, the invocation timeout bounds the response.

every.description: Native recurring heartbeat interval, such as 30m or 1h30m. Units are required; 0m disables the recurring cadence but not event-driven turns.

enabled.description: Whether OpenClaw runs its pre-compaction memory flush turn. This does not stop compaction itself.

agents.description: Native OpenClaw agents.defaults controls for NeMo Fabric-owned Gateways. Only authored fields are written; attached Gateways reject them.

notifyOnExit.description: Whether OpenClaw emits a system event and heartbeat when a backgrounded exec process exits.

toolSearch.description: Whether OpenClaw compacts large tool catalogs behind search tools.

codeMode.description: Whether OpenClaw Code Mode is enabled. Code Mode can take precedence over tool search.

tools.description: Native OpenClaw tools controls for NeMo Fabric-owned Gateways, merged with the allow and deny lists generated from NeMo Fabric's normalized top-level tools. Only authored fields are written; attached Gateways reject them.

enabled.description: Whether the memory-core plugin runs scheduled dreaming.

plugins.description: Native OpenClaw plugin controls for NeMo Fabric-owned Gateways. Only authored fields are written; attached Gateways reject them.

supports_usage_in_streaming.description: Whether the configured custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint supports stream_options.include_usage. Requires base_url; omitted values retain OpenClaw capability detection.
